rows.grounds: compound denoting that which awakens or reveals the state of Brahman-ness
optative or imperative expression of wish or benediction
refers to the practitioner or subject in view
the subtle channel described in the preceding verses as the locus of lotuses and abodes

items.question: What capacity does the navel-stalk lotus-fiber hold for realizing Brahman-ness in the practitioner?
premises: The navel-stalk lotus-fiber is the established subtle locus described previously.
Brahman-ness is a state that can be awakened or revealed.
A benediction is expressed that this locus serve as an awakener for the practitioner.
items.inference: The navel-stalk lotus-fiber functions as the means by which Brahman-ness is awakened in the practitioner.
uncertainties: The specific referent of asya is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: May this navel-stalk lotus-fiber be the awakener of Brahman-ness for him.
